summary: Shinhan Financial Group filed a Form 6-K reporting that its largest shareholder, Korea's National Pension Service, reduced its common share stake from 42,747,919 shares (9.01%) to 42,575,588 shares (8.97%) as of April 30, 2026. No consideration, premium, or board recommendation is provided. This routine ownership update does not constitute a special situation such as a tender offer or activist campaign. What to watch: further dilution or acquisition signals, though no immediate catalyst.
